card.name: The word crop in farming text
card.fires_on: The word "crop" or "crops" (including the split form C|rops) in agriculture and plant-growing text. It appears as a noun or as a modifier before words like fields, residues, or systems.

modes.label: Crop as modifier
modes.description: "crop" sits before another noun such as fields, systems, or residues.
modes.example: The<< crop>> fields contain Common and Sarus Cranes

modes.label: Crops as plural noun
modes.description: The plural "crops" appears, often split after a capital C.
modes.example: C<<rops>> can take years to recover and homes years

card.plain: It lights up on the word "crop" or "crops" when the text is about farming and plants grown for harvest.
